full_judgment: 16. DW 1 produced a copy of allotment letter dated 6-7-1963 and adduced in evidence the original lease deed number 14437 dated 21-10-1963 (Exhibit Ka), permission dated 3-2-1964 for construction of building on the suit plot (Exhibit Kha), Letter of Guarantee for loans dated 16-7-1964 executed by Mainuddin (Exhibit Ga), sale permission dated 19-12-1987 (Exhibit Gha), mutation dated 7-7-1987 in the name of Mainuddin (Exhibit,Uma), citizenship certificate dated 5-12-1968 in favour of Mainuddin (Exhibit Cha), sale deed number 6077 dated 18-8-1988 executed and registered by Mainuddin in his favour (Exhibit Chha), letter dated 25-9-1988 issued by the Ministry of Public Works (Exhibit Chha), mutation of record in the name of defendant number 1 vide letter dated 26-9-1988 (Exhibit JO, clearance certificate dated 23-1-1989 (Exhibit Jha), duplicate carbon receipt (DCR) dated 30-4-1989 issued by the Settlement Office (Exhibit Neo), mutated Khatian Number 15420 and rent receipt in the name of defendant number 1 (Exhibit Tta series and Ttha), municipal Tax receipt (Exhibit Da), WASA receipt (Exhibit Na), letter of the Ministry of Public Works dated 20-11-1989 (Exhibit Ta), resolution of the meeting dated 28-5-1992 presided over by the Joint Secretary (Police), Ministry of Home Affairs (Exhibit Tha); letter dated 19-1-1993 and similar letters issued by the Ministry of Home (Exhibit Da series), judgment and decree dated 8-9-1996 passed in Title Suit Number 219 of 1994 (Exhibit Dha series) and the original mortgage deed dated 20-7-1964 executed by Zainul Abedin (Exhibit Bha) etcetera.
